transferRemoved: File no longer shared by owner
feedbackRateLimited: You're sending feedback too quickly. Please wait a moment and try again.
folderNotSupported: Folders aren't supported yet — pick individual files.
sourceNotOnDisk: This item isn't saved to disk yet — save it first, then share it.
mountOverlaps: This folder is already being shared or mirrored. Choose a different folder.
mountForbiddenSystem: System folders can't be shared. Choose a folder in your home directory.
mountForbiddenAppData: This is Mirall's own data folder and can't be shared.
mountForbiddenWinReserved: This path uses a name reserved by Windows. Choose a different folder.
mountForbiddenCloudSync: Cloud-synced folders (Dropbox, iCloud, OneDrive…) can't be shared. Double-syncing risks data loss — choose a folder outside your cloud-sync area.
mountForbiddenPersonalRoot: This is a top-level personal folder (Home, Desktop, Documents, or Downloads). Choose or create a subfolder inside it instead.
mountInsideDownloads: This is inside your downloads folder. Choose a location outside it.
mountInsideSelf: This folder is inside another shared folder. Choose a different folder.
mountNotWritable: Mirall can't write to this folder. Check its permissions or choose another.
looseFileLimit: You can share up to 100 files per space. Remove some to add more.
shareFileLimit: Shared folders are limited to 5,000 files. Choose a smaller folder, or split it into several shares.
